summary: Argument Library v3.9.1 — legibility sweep: real-world-example cards re-registered to the library's fixed-px type scale with full legible / high-contrast mode adaptation, UI chrome labels lifted off the sub-10px floor, and 14 rebuttal grade-bands corrected against the canonical band rule; 81 objections / 35 mechanisms / 136 examples / 15 variant carriers held.

Argument Library v3.9.0 — archetype-variant rebuttal registers live on 15 nodes (11 defender, 5 sophisticate; per-card toggle) plus 136 real-world deployment examples as expandable cards; 81 objections / 35 mechanisms held.
Argument Library updated to v3.8.22 — 81 objections / 35 mechanisms, with regraded rebuttals and a cleared danger-quadrant; actively maintained, not archived.

The Void Engine now flags what's new for you — fresh prompts and categories glow until you've seen them (remembered on your device, no tracking). Plus a pinned stat header, model-agnostic targeting copy, site-matched accent colors, a clearer Diagnosis form, and a new figure-DNA prompt filter for the figure sets. Still 334 prompts across 19 categories.

The Void Engine lexicon grew to 334 prompts across 19 categories -- Apophatica, Luminous-Void, and Void / Dissolution deepened, the Figure sets broadened, and the Chaos reroll now takes a scoped multi-select so you can aim the randomness instead of only shielding it.
The comment board is live on the Chat page — leave a public note for me or anyone reading, anonymous or signed. Be civil; spam and bad faith get removed.
Added this changelog, an RSS feed, and a nav indicator that glows when a section you haven't visited has changed.
Void Engine lexicon expanded to 310 entries across 19 categories.
Archive expanded with additional video selections and a content disclaimer.
Gallery images optimized for faster loading; Recommendations filled out across film, books, art, groups, and media; Support, Contact, and Chat tabs added.

wuld.ink registered and launched — the umbrella for all of WULD's philosophical output. Core surfaces stood up: Essays, Glossary, Book, and Blog.
